paths.name: @/data/machine
paths.message: Only the pairing's slot (src/data/pairing-scope.tsx) opens a machine. Take `usePairing().machine` in a hook or component, or a `machine` parameter in a plain function, captured before any await.

paths.name: @/data/pairing-config
paths.message: The current pairing is not the pairing that started your work. Take `usePairing().machine` (or `usePairing().config` for what the screen shows), or a `machine` parameter in a plain function.

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Requests go through the pairing's machine, which carries its address and bearer: `usePairing().machine.read(…)` / `.write(…)`, or a `machine` parameter in a plain function.

no-restricted-globals.name: XMLHttpRequest
no-restricted-globals.message: Uploads go through the pairing's machine: `usePairing().machine.upload(…)`, or a `machine` parameter in a plain function.
